profile:
COMPANY NAME: Clearwater
INDUSTRY: Financial Technology / Investment Management Software
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: A unified, front-to-back investment management platform that consolidates data, operations, risk analytics, and execution across the entire investment lifecycle.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Institutional investors including asset managers, asset owners (pension funds, endowments, corporations), insurers, and hedge funds.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise
KEY FEATURES:
- Unified operational backbone automating complex, multi-step workflows across reconciliation, reporting, accounting, and compliance.
- Beacon by Clearwater: AI-powered risk analytics and modeling tools for real-time scenario analysis and portfolio insights.
- Enfusion by Clearwater: Integrated environment for portfolio construction, trading, and order management execution.
- AI-driven workflow layer with 1,000+ AI agents actively executing investment tasks.
- Single data foundation processing daily investment activity for over $10 trillion in assets.
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- "One dataset, total clarity" approach eliminating siloed systems and fragmented data.
- Embedded, purpose-driven AI capabilities rather than bolt-on solutions.
- Proven scale and reliability, evidenced by a 60+ "excellent" NPS score and 95% reduction in reporting time.
- Comprehensive visibility across all asset classes (public and private) through a single pane of glass.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Premium / Institutional
